resources.string: We\'ll look through the next 12 months of your phone\'s calendar for flights, like booking confirmations or reminders you added, and list them for you to add.
Your calendar is read on this phone only and nothing from it is uploaded. Android will ask you to allow calendar access.
Looking for flights in your calendar…
Calendar import is part of Pro.
Pro reads your phone\'s calendar for upcoming flights and adds them in a tap.
To find flights, HeyGate needs to read your calendar. It only reads; it never changes or uploads your events.
